overlap_note: The India Code ingest already holds the consolidated bare Acts for PATENT, TRADEMARK, COPYRIGHT, DESIGN. The DATA corpus adds Rules, Manuals, Guidelines and Amendment Acts for those domains, plus GEOGRAPHICAL_INDICATION and AYUSH_REGULATORY which the KB lacks entirely. It does not cover BIODIVERSITY_ABS or REGULATORY (Drugs & Cosmetics), which India Code supplies.
